source.title: Online Retail
source.creator: Daqing Chen
source.transformations: whole-invoice eligibility filtering, deterministic invoice sampling, exact derived subtotals

selection.selection: ascending SHA256(UTF-8 invoice_id), then invoice_id; first sample_size eligible invoices
selection.goods_stock_code_rule: five digits followed by zero to two ASCII letters; syntactic filter only
selection.numeric_rules: positive integral Quantity; positive finite decimal UnitPrice and InvoiceDate
selection.invoice_id_rule: six digits, with all C-prefixed cancellation invoices excluded
selection.customer_id_rule: five digits as provided by anonymized source
selection.duplicates: identical values in all eight columns exclude the whole invoice; business meaning unknown
selection.quality_counts: independent reasons can overlap; duplicate counts include original observations
selection.exact_subtotal: sum(Quantity * original XML UnitPrice decimal), with no line rounding
selection.display_subtotal: presentation assumption only: exact subtotal rounded once to GBP 0.01, ROUND_HALF_UP
selection.tax_discount_shipping: not invented; source rows with non-goods codes exclude their whole invoice

ground_truth: Original observed SKU, description, quantity, price, row coordinates; no original invoice totals or tax/discount labels
validation_scope: Historical transaction inputs for deterministic pricing and governed changes; not production customer or ROI proof
